# Vibemaster

> Vibemaster is an AI-powered workspace that transforms product ideas into structured, buildable specifications.

## What is Vibemaster?

Vibemaster bridges the gap between a product idea and the technical instructions that AI coding tools need to build it. It interviews founders, product managers, and developers about their idea and produces a complete Markdown build prompt, a human-readable project plan, and an implementation timeline.

The output is designed to work directly with AI builders such as Lovable, Cursor, Bolt.new, Replit, Google AI Studio, and Claude Code — without vague prompts or broken builds.

## Who is it for?

- Founders and creators (both technical and non-technical) who want to build digital products
- Product managers who need clear technical specifications
- Developers who want a structured architecture before building

## What does Vibemaster produce?

- A structured Markdown build prompt ready for AI coding tools
- A human-readable project plan
- An implementation timeline
- Features breakdown, user flows, data model, and AI build instructions

## How it works

1. Describe your idea in plain language
2. Vibemaster interviews you to uncover hidden technical requirements
3. The output is a complete, structured specification you paste directly into your AI builder of choice

## Pricing

- Free: 1 project per month, basic technical specs, Markdown export
- Professional (€9/month): Unlimited projects, version history, PDF & Markdown export, priority generation queue. BYOK (Bring Your Own API Key) coming soon.
- Team (€49/month, coming soon): Up to 6 seats, shared projects
- Enterprise: Custom pricing, dedicated support

## Technology & Compliance

- Hosted on Scalingo infrastructure in Paris, France
- GDPR compliant — all data stays within EU jurisdiction
- EU AI Act ready
- Privacy by design
